About Shokz
At Shokz, we're redefining the listening experience through innovative open-ear audio technology. As our business continues to grow globally, we're looking for passionate Marketing Specialists to strengthen our brand presence and build meaningful connections with consumers across North America. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who loves sports, enjoys working with people, and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

This posting covers the roles listed below. You only need to apply once, and our recruiting team will match you with the role that best fits your experience and interests. You may be considered for one of the following positions:

[1. User Research Specialist]
What You'll Do
Plan and execute qualitative and quantitative consumer research projects that support marketing strategy, brand initiatives, and business decision-making across North America.
Recruit participants for consumer and market research while building scalable, cost-effective recruitment channels and local research resources.
Conduct agile field research to validate emerging consumer needs, sports scenarios, and market opportunities through interviews, observations, intercepts, and other in-market research methods.
Identify localized consumer behaviors, cultural insights, and market trends to help the business better understand North American consumers.
Collaborate closely with the Global Consumer Insights team in China throughout the research process, including research design, participant recruitment, fieldwork, insight generation, and reporting.
Respond quickly to ad hoc research requests from regional teams and deliver actionable insights within fast-moving business timelines.
Support research activities during sporting events, trade shows, community activations, and other offline marketing initiatives across North America.
Continuously expand local research resources by developing relationships with agencies, communities, organizations, and alternative participant recruitment channels to improve research quality while optimizing costs.

What We're Looking For
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or above.
1–3 years of experience in User Research, Consumer Insights, UX Research, or Market Research.
Experience working in multinational companies or research agencies serving global brands.
Experience recruiting research participants and coordinating field research activities.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships across diverse communities.
Fluent in English.

[2. Influencer & Community Marketing]
What You'll Do
Develop and execute influencer and community marketing initiatives across North America.
Identify and build relationships with influencers, creators, athletes, coaches, and sports communities.
Manage influencer collaborations, including outreach, campaign execution, content coordination, and performance tracking.
Build and grow local communities around key sports and lifestyle categories, such as running, fitness, cycling, hiking, and skiing.
Plan and support community activations, sporting events, expos, and other local marketing initiatives.
Identify and develop partnerships with sports clubs, communities, events, and local organizations.
Monitor local social media and consumer trends to identify new influencers, communities, and marketing opportunities.
Work closely with global marketing teams to localize strategies for the North American market.
Continuously expand Shokz's local influencer, community, and marketing resources.

What We're Looking For
Bachelor's degree or above.
1–3 years of experience in Influencer Marketing, Community Marketing, Sports Marketing, Social Media Marketing, or related fields.
Experience working with influencers, creators, athletes, or communities.
Strong communication, relationship-building, and project management skills.
Fluent in English.
Passion for sports, fitness, or outdoor activities.

[3. Sports Event Marketing]
What You'll Do
Event Planning & Execution: Organize and execute event marketing activities in targeted U.S. cities, including running clubs, sports communities, and marathon events.
Brand Integration: Develop strategies to effectively integrate the brand into events, ensuring maximum visibility and engagement with potential customers.
User Engagement: Engage with target audiences at events to enhance brand awareness, promote product features, and collect user feedback.
Partnership Development: Collaborate with local sports organizations, influencers, and event coordinators to build strong partnerships and expand brand presence.
Sales Support: Utilize event opportunities to support sales efforts, including lead generation, follow-up, and conversion tracking.
Data Analysis & Reporting: Monitor and report on the success of marketing events, including ROI, brand reach, and customer engagement.

What We're Looking For
Personality Traits: Highly outgoing, passionate, and enthusiastic with a strong sales orientation. Proven ability to drive results through interpersonal communication.
Brand Passion: A genuine love for the Shokz brand and its products, with the ability to effectively represent and promote the brand.
Love for Sports: Passionate about sports and fitness, with a personal commitment to an active lifestyle. Previous experience in sports industry marketing (equipment, event sponsorships) like Nike, Adidas, Asics or community management (specifically referring to running or cycling communities) is a plus.
Travel Requirements: Willingness and ability to travel frequently across the U.S. for event execution.
Language Skills: Proficiency in English is required.

Experience in hearing aids resellers, independent hearing center management.
Experience working with major US hearing aid insurance providers , such as Blue Cross Blue Shield, UnitedHealthcare, VA.
Able to identify potential clients and customer groups in the local and national markets with knowledge of competitor operations, strengths and strategies

Our Ideal Candidate
Creates and maintains effective partner relationships with Shokz partner principles nationally

Why work for us
Shokz INC is a leading global bone conduction technology company with offices in Austin, Texas, USA. We are a pioneer and key player in the bone conduction sports headphone industry, holding over 2,000 bone conduction-related patents worldwide and boasting the world's largest sales volume of bone conduction headphones.

OpenHear Hearing Aids are our new flagship product line built on the latest bone conduction technology. Featuring unique bone conduction technology and breakthrough comfort, they address the drawbacks of existing hearing aids in terms of appearance and ease of use. They are expected to capture greater market opportunities among those with conductive, mixed, and mild to moderate sensorineural hearing loss.

Position Overview
We are seeking a hands-on technical professional with a strong security mindset, practical experience in AWS cloud environments, and a high level of ownership. This role will be responsible for day-to-day security operations across North American systems, maintaining the U.S. data environment, and managing access controls to support the company’s data compliance obligations and business growth in the United States.
Initially, the role will focus on cloud infrastructure and IT operations, implementation of security controls, and audit support. As the business grows, the position will gradually evolve into a local information security leadership role, driving the development of security policies and serving as a key security point of contact for management, business teams, and external auditors.
Key Responsibilities
Security Operations for North American Systems
Maintain an inventory of systems, cloud resources, endpoint devices, and software assets.
Conduct security configuration reviews, vulnerability scans, patch management, and remediation tracking.
Monitor unusual access patterns and security alerts; participate in security incident investigation, response, and post-incident reviews.
AWS Data Environment & Infrastructure Operations
Maintain the U.S. AWS environment, including data ingestion, storage, compute resources, and related services, ensuring system stability and availability.
Handle routine configuration, troubleshooting, backup and recovery, monitoring and alerting, and optimization of capacity and cloud costs as needed.
Data Access Approval & Access Control Management
Within the scope of delegated authority, take substantive responsibility for security reviews of system and data access requests, including approving or denying requests, configuring permissions, and conducting periodic access reviews.
Enforce the principle of least privilege, multi-factor authentication (MFA), segregation of duties, and access management throughout employee onboarding, internal transfers, and offboarding.
Perform additional reviews for privileged access, sensitive data access, and exceptions to standard access policies, ensuring that approval decisions and related actions are fully traceable.
Data Compliance & Audit Support
Work with Legal, Compliance, and external auditors to implement applicable U.S. state-level data security requirements.
Prepare and maintain audit evidence, including asset inventories, data flows, access records, system activity logs, and remediation documentation.
Support the implementation and verification of corrective actions arising from audits or compliance reviews.
Cloud-Based AI Agent Operations Support
Support the deployment, operational monitoring, and troubleshooting of AI agents within the U.S. cloud environment for data tagging, report generation, and operational assistance.
Manage service accounts, credentials, and tool invocation permissions.
Implement security controls and logging for data access, model service calls, and output generation.
Corporate IT & Hardware/Software Support
Provide essential IT support for the U.S. team, including user accounts, business software, endpoint devices, and basic network operations.
Coordinate with vendors on device configuration, hardware repairs, and service issues to ensure business continuity.
Security Policy Development & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Establish and maintain operational standards for access control, change management, log retention, incident response, and routine IT operations.
Report key security risks and remediation progress to management.
Provide security guidance to business teams and support security questionnaires and assessments from customers and business partners.
Qualifications
Relevant Experience: 1-3 years of experience in enterprise IT, cloud operations, information security, or a related field, with hands-on experience independently maintaining production environments. Candidates with experience in security management, audit coordination, or security policy development may be considered for a higher-level position.
AWS Hands-on Experience: Practical knowledge of AWS data storage, identity and access management, logging, monitoring, and basic cloud operations. Experience using services such as IAM, S3, CloudTrail, and CloudWatch to perform operational tasks is required, along with a foundational understanding of networking, encryption, backup, and recovery.
Security Controls Implementation: Understanding of least privilege, role-based access control (RBAC), sensitive data protection, vulnerability management, and incident response. Ability to translate security requirements into practical configurations, operational processes, and auditable records.
Systems & Data Fundamentals: Familiarity with Linux or Windows system administration, basic SQL, and scripting. Ability to support data ingestion, job scheduling, and routine troubleshooting.
Compliance Awareness: Familiarity with U.S. data security and privacy requirements, with the ability to work with Legal and audit professionals to translate applicable requirements into operational procedures.
Communication & Professional Integrity: Strong professional English communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work independently with U.S. business teams and external stakeholders. A strong commitment to confidentiality, sound judgment, and the consistent enforcement of access policies, with timely escalation of identified risks.
Preferred Qualifications
An active CISSP certification. CISM, CCSP, or relevant AWS security certifications are also advantageous.
Experience integrating, operating, or managing access controls for Salesforce, Klaviyo, business intelligence (BI) tools, or customer data platforms (CDPs).
Experience with data compliance, security audits, data governance, or cross-border data access controls.
Familiarity with containers, operations automation, infrastructure as code (IaC), or experience deploying and supporting AI agents.
Previous experience as an information security lead or independently driving the development of an enterprise security program.
Initial Priorities
During the initial onboarding period, the successful candidate will be expected to:
Assess the current state of the U.S. cloud environment, IT assets, and access permissions, and develop a documented risk register and remediation plan.
Establish reliable processes for access request reviews and approvals, log inspections, and vulnerability remediation.
Gradually improve operational documentation and audit evidence to establish a solid foundation for ongoing security governance.
